name: HeyGen
shortDescription: Avatar and spokesperson video from a script. Free to start; paid plans on their site.
longDescription: HeyGen makes avatar and spokesperson videos. The pricing page lists $0 per month alongside $29 and $49 per month samples.
freeTierNotes: 3 videos per month, up to 1 minute each.
bestFor: Teams that want a hosted avatar tool with a $0 tier on the pricing page
strength: The free plan includes 3 avatar videos per month, up to 1 minute each.
weakness: Free videos are capped at one minute, and the next plan starts at $29 per month.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.avatar-video: Generates an avatar or spokesperson video from a script.
